row: For more than 100 years, Mercy Medical Center has delivered The Mercy Touch® by partnering the latest technology with compassionate and high-quality patient care. Mercy is a fully-accredited 445 licensed-bed regional hospital.  Founded in 1900 by the Sisters of Mercy, today it offers a wide range of patient services, including state-of-the art cancer care delivered at the ACoS-accredited Mercy Regional Cancer Center.  Additional strengths include surgical services, emergency services, cardiac care, critical care services, women's services and obstetrics. Mercy is the only hospital in the eastern Iowa Corridor to offer all-private acute patient rooms.
